// ParseFloat parses a Redis RESP3 float reply into a Go float64,
// handling "inf", "-inf", "nan" per Redis conventions.
func ( string) (float64, error) {
	switch  {
	case "inf":
		return math.Inf(1), nil
	case "-inf":
		return math.Inf(-1), nil
	case "nan", "-nan":
		return math.NaN(), nil
	}
	return strconv.ParseFloat(, 64)
}

// SafeIntToInt32 safely converts an int to int32, returning an error if overflow would occur.
func ( int,  string) (int32, error) {
	if  > math.MaxInt32 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("redis: %s value %d exceeds maximum allowed value %d", , , math.MaxInt32)
	}
	if  < math.MinInt32 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("redis: %s value %d is below minimum allowed value %d", , , math.MinInt32)
	}
	return int32(), nil
}
